<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_Luxury_Airplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Specifications" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements_Russian" name="Vodka bar requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements_Irish" name="Whiskey bar requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Parts_Russian" name="Vodka bar parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Parts_Irish" name="Whiskey bar parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Test_Protocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Delivery" name="Delivered airplane"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Luxury_Airplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane manufacturer" processRef="Process_Manufacturing"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Russian_Team" name="Russian team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Irish_Team" name="Irish team"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Specifications" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Specifications_Received"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Requirements_Russian" name="Vodka bar requirements" sourceRef="Task_Send_Requirements_Russian" targetRef="Participant_Russian_Team"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Requirements_Irish" name="Whiskey bar requirements" sourceRef="Task_Send_Requirements_Irish" targetRef="Participant_Irish_Team"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Parts_Russian" name="Vodka bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_Russian_Team" targetRef="Task_Receive_Vodka_Bar_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Parts_Irish" name="Whiskey bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_Irish_Team" targetRef="Task_Receive_Whiskey_Bar_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Test_Protocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="Task_Send_Test_Protocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Delivery" name="Delivered airplane" sourceRef="Task_Deliver_Airplane" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_Receive_Delivery_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturing" name="Airplane manufacturing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Specifications_Received" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Requirements_Split" name="Split requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Russian</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Irish</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Requirements_Russian" name="Send requirements to Russian team" messageRef="Msg_Requirements_Russian">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Russian</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Russian_Send_To_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Requirements_Irish" name="Send requirements to Irish team" messageRef="Msg_Requirements_Irish">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Irish</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Irish_Send_To_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_Receive_Vodka_Bar_Parts" name="Receive vodka bar parts" messageRef="Msg_Parts_Russian">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Russian_Send_To_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Vodka_Parts_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_Receive_Whiskey_Bar_Parts" name="Receive whiskey bar parts" messageRef="Msg_Parts_Irish">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Irish_Send_To_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Whiskey_Parts_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parts_Join" name="All parts received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Vodka_Parts_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Whiskey_Parts_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_To_Assembly</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble_Interior" name="Assemble interior">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_To_Assembly</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assembly_To_Test_Flight</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Perform_Test_Flight" name="Perform test flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assembly_To_Test_Flight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Flight_To_Protocol</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Create_Test_Protocol" name="Create test protocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Flight_To_Protocol</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Protocol_To_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Test_Protocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Msg_Test_Protocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Protocol_To_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send_Protocol_To_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Deliver_Airplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send_Protocol_To_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deliver_To_Confirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_Receive_Delivery_Confirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deliver_To_Confirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Airplane_Delivered" name="Airplane delivered and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Split" sourceRef="Start_Specifications_Received" targetRef="Gateway_Requirements_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Russian" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_Requirements_Russian"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Irish" sourceRef="Gateway_Requirements_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_Requirements_Irish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Russian_Send_To_Receive" sourceRef="Task_Send_Requirements_Russian" targetRef="Task_Receive_Vodka_Bar_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Irish_Send_To_Receive" sourceRef="Task_Send_Requirements_Irish" targetRef="Task_Receive_Whiskey_Bar_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Vodka_Parts_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_Receive_Vodka_Bar_Parts" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Whiskey_Parts_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_Receive_Whiskey_Bar_Parts" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_Assembly" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Join" targetRef="Task_Assemble_Interior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assembly_To_Test_Flight" sourceRef="Task_Assemble_Interior" targetRef="Task_Perform_Test_Flight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Flight_To_Protocol" sourceRef="Task_Perform_Test_Flight" targetRef="Task_Create_Test_Protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Protocol_To_Send" sourceRef="Task_Create_Test_Protocol" targetRef="Task_Send_Test_Protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Protocol_To_Deliver" sourceRef="Task_Send_Test_Protocol" targetRef="Task_Deliver_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_To_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_Deliver_Airplane" targetRef="Task_Receive_Delivery_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_To_End" sourceRef="Task_Receive_Delivery_Confirmation" targetRef="End_Airplane_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_Luxury_Airplane">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_Luxury_Airplane" bpmnElement="Collaboration_Luxury_Airplane"/>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
